mapper.select: SELECT ranked.id, ranked.device_id, ranked.address, ranked.opened, ranked.locked, ranked.lock_status, ranked.delay_time, ranked.create_at, ranked.update_at, ranked.delete_at FROM ( SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.is_open AS opened, r.is_lock AS locked, r.lock_status, r.delay_time, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.device_id ORDER BY r.create_at DESC, r.id DESC ) AS row_num FROM access_record r WHERE r.delete_at IS NULL AND r.device_id IN #{id} ) ranked WHERE ranked.row_num = 1
